Release 6.5.1 - discount given as the new total
nodes.rationale: A discount on the check is usually a round figure (53.40, call it 50) that had to be worked out by hand and typed as an amount.

nodes.label: Discount given as the new total (discount_type total, target_total)
nodes.rationale: The server works the discount out against the order as it stands inside the transaction and from the check without any discount, so a dish a handheld adds meanwhile moves the discount, never the typed total, and rounding again replaces the first rounding; the total cannot go below the cover and other charges because a discount only comes off the food.

nodes.label: Round-figure proposals (cents dropped, down to 5, down to 10)
nodes.rationale: Only figures below the check and not below the cover are offered, so every proposal is a valid new total.

nodes.label: Remove discount in the discount window
nodes.rationale: The window had no way to take off a discount given by mistake.

nodes.label: Per-method discount switches, discount_methods (migration v99)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the discount_mode drop-down; the migration keeps what the old choice allowed and switches New total on everywhere, and the last method on cannot be switched off.

nodes.label: Discount window opens on the first method switched on, no Cancel button
nodes.rationale: At 1024x690 three buttons at the foot did not fit, so it closes with X, Escape or a tap outside.

nodes.label: One rule for carrying an order discount when the check changes
nodes.rationale: Correcting a row price scaled a euro discount with the subtotal, so an agreed round figure drifted; now a percentage is recomputed on the food while a euro amount or new total stays as agreed, capped at the food left and restored if the food comes back.
